items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: And I let Jacquet hear it and he said he wanted to borrow it

ctx.x: They did Still King For Once in My Life, Every Day I have the blues, The blues thats me, The Gallopin' Latin...

-They named one after me. "The Blues That's me", I believe, ... But he took a tape from me that I valued very good and all I asked for was a copy of it. ... We were workin' at Buddy Rich's and the sound man had a good outfit and I paid him to make me a tape of one of the sets and the tape came out very good-- excellent. As if it was made in the studio. And I let Jacquet hear it and he said he wanted to borrow it I said yeah, you take it and copy it off and give it back. And he never did. And that's how we fell…
When you went to Europe with Milt Buckner the first time did you go there with other musicians? Did you play with any European musicians?
